title: Egg Freezing Procedures at Public and Private Hospitals
what_it_is: Egg Freezing Procedures at Public and Private Hospitals

sections.label: Egg freezing rules and IVF data
sections.summary: Egg freezing is allowed only for married IVF patients or women with medical conditions, and MOH monitors IVF cycles, not egg freezing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Egg freezing is currently only allowed either as part of an in-vitro fertilisation (IVF) procedure for married women, or for women diagnosed with medical conditions, such as cancer, for which the treatment may damage or destroy their ovarian functions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: At present, the Ministry of Health monitors the number of IVF cycles carried out, rather than the egg freezing procedures conducted.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: From 2013 to 2015, an annual average of 2,700 and 1,400 fresh IVF cycles was carried out respectively in public and private assisted reproduction centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Based on estimates from licensed centres conducting IVF, complications from over-stimulation of ovaries, which could result in abdominal pain and vomiting in severe cases, occur in less than 1% of the cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Likewise, the risk of infection and bleeding is low, with a prevalence of less than 1%.

sections.label: Social egg freezing disallowed in Singapore
sections.summary: Social egg freezing is currently disallowed in Singapore, and there are various reasons for this.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As the Member has rightly noted, social egg freezing is currently disallowed in Singapore and there are various reasons for this.

sections.label: Review of social egg freezing
sections.summary: Authorities are considering allowing social egg freezing, monitoring international developments and weighing safeguards, implications and societal norms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Nonetheless, we note the feedback that we have received.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are currently carefully considering the implications of allowing social egg freezing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are monitoring international developments in the field of social egg freezing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will review our position, taking into account the experiences of countries that have implemented this, as well as, of course, the proper safeguards that we need, for instance, the regulatory framework, to ensure or safeguard patients' safety should social egg freezing be allowed, as well as social and medical implications, and the prevailing societal norms and culture.
